column4: Roadways are slick due to icy conditions.  Use extreme caution.  There are numerous collisions reported and various roadways are shut down.

column5: The roadway is shut down due to jackknifed semis.  Traffic is backed up and stopped in both directions starting near Exit 104 northbound and Exit 110 southbound.
